spec.scope: Self stat buff; maxAmmoPct 25.66 per stack, maxStacks 5 — a weapon-state modifier that gates shot count (larger magazine → fewer reloads → more shots), NOT a defensive skip.

spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount count:30 (counts landed ROUNDS; AR hitsPerShot 1 so rounds = pulls). Repeating — fires every 30 cumulative hits, not once.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Dropped/skipped as a 'defensive, no damage' line (failure-mode 6), or modeled without stacking (single 25.66% instead of up to 5 stacks = +128.3% capacity).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: In controlComp(carry): buffApply events with stat 'maxAmmoPct', value 25.66, targetSlug=carry appear starting ~the 30th landed hit and 'stacks' climbs to 5 during sustained fire; her reload-event count is strictly LOWER (and shot count higher) than the same run with this block removed via withPatchedOverride. Red if the buff is absent, unstacked, or reload count is unchanged.

spec.kitLine: Deals 188.68% of final ATK as damage

spec.distinguishingAssertion: Count damage events with mult 188.68 (srcSlot=carry, skill1 bucket) over 180s ≈ floor(her total landed normal hits / 30) — i.e. dozens of procs, with the count scaling when firing uptime changes (e.g. it RISES when her unlimited-ammo windows are active because hits accrue faster). Red under a fires-once model (count = 1) or a fixed-interval model (count invariant to hit rate).
spec.inertness: Proc count must track HITS, not wall-clock — patching her fire cadence down must reduce proc count.

spec.kitLine: Deals 61.69% of final ATK as damage
spec.scope: flatDamage atkPct 61.69, skill2 bucket, single boss ('all enemies' collapses). Default rider FB/range/core rules as above.
spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount count:50 — repeating, counts landed rounds. CRITICAL: the burst's 'Hit count required for Skill 2 ▼ 20' line lowers this threshold to 30 for 10s after HER OWN burst cast only (see burst line 1).

Green under own-burst gating; red under plain countInFb (spacing 30 in helm-led FBs too).
spec.inertness: Threshold outside her own 10s windows must remain 50 at all times, including during helm-led Full Bursts.

spec.scope: 'Attack damage ▲' is the Damage-Up bucket → stat attackDamagePct, NOT atkPct. Bucket identity is load-bearing: attackDamagePct dilutes additively with other Damage-Up sources, atkPct would compound with her burst's ATK ▲ 97.2% instead.

spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply events with stat 'attackDamagePct', value 21.12, targetSlug=carry occur exactly once per HER burstCast event, count == her burstCast count and < fullBurstStart count when helm takes some rotations. Red if the apply count equals the FB count, or if the stat key is 'atkPct'.

All three misreads go red on at least one leg of this two-sided spacing assertion.

spec.scope: Self ATK stat → atkPct 97.2 (scales her own ATK; for a self-target this is equivalent to caster-scaled, but atkPct is the literal encoding).

spec.nearestWrongModel: Keyed to fullBurstEnter (fires on helm-led FBs too), or stat mis-bucketed as attackDamagePct (Damage-Up dilution instead of ATK-term scaling — materially different final damage when composed with s2's 21.12% attackDamagePct).

Red if applies appear on helm-led rotations or the stat key is attackDamagePct.

spec.scope: unlimitedAmmo effect, durationSec 10 — pure fire-uptime damage (no reload downtime for 10s; her 60-round AR magazine would otherwise empty inside a 10s window, so this deletes ≥1 reload per burst rotation). Infinite-ammo shots also don't consume ammo (no lastBullet during the window).

notes: Expected shared-prior misreads, in order of likelihood: (1) The burst's hit-count reduction encoded as plain hitCount countInFb — the control fixture deliberately includes helm as co-B3, so team-FB-keyed encodings (countInFb for the threshold, fullBurstEnter for the two self buffs and unlimited ammo) over-credit every helm-led rotation; every burst-slot assertion above is two-sided (her windows vs helm-led windows) to catch this. (2) '▼ 20 time(s)' read as 'set to 20' instead of 'reduce by 20 → 30'. (3) The s1 Max Ammunition stack line skipped as defensive — it is a shot-count gate and its 5-stack ceiling (+128% capacity) materially cuts reload downtime; assert via reload-count A/B, not just buffApply presence. (4) 'Attack damage ▲ 21.12%' mis-bucketed as atkPct (or the burst's ATK ▲ 97.2% as attackDamagePct) — the two lines coexist in her own burst window, so bucket identity changes composition; assert on the emitted stat keys. (5) Both hit-count damage riders read as one-time instead of repeating — assert proc counts scale with landed hits. Counter hygiene: skill1's 30-hit counter and skill2's 50-hit counter are independent; the burst reduction touches ONLY skill2's. All magnitudes are kit-literal (DATAMINED); no ALWAYS-⚑ field is exercised except default noFb/range conventions on the two flat-damage riders, which follow engine defaults. The effect-schema comments mention base snow-white (a different unit, exact-slug rule) — not a leak of this unit's answer.
